title: enter: Show more toggle for clamped model descriptions
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Long model descriptions on Enter’s models page can now be expanded in both desktop and mobile rows instead of being permanently cut off after two lines. A Show more / Show less button appears only when the text is truncated, with ResizeObserver updating that check as the layout changes. Expanding removes the clamp in place, leaving the full description selectable; the button supports keyboard, touch, and mouse and exposes its state through aria-expanded and aria-controls.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and opens a folded model-description card beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant, revealing more lines of text while a CRT robot reads along. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or dominating, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
